name: SMSFactor
description: SMSFactor is an online platform allowing you to send professional SMS to your clients/patients.

events.d: Send a text message to a recipient, with optional scheduling, sender name, message type, and custom SMS ID.

Returns SMS messages sent or received between specified start and end dates. Optional filters include destination number, message content, type (incoming/outgoing), country, and status; supports sorting and pagination.
Create a new SMS contact list and add one contact using the recipient's phone number.
Create a new reusable SMS template.
Create a new SMSFactor account or sub-account using the provided email, password, and optional profile details.
